title: Four sides, one loop
heading: Four sides, one loop
description: The same two instructions make every side. The loop repeats its indented lines four times. Replace pass with robot.move(3). Then try three repetitions: which side is missing?

scene.label: A robot starts in the upper left corner of a dotted square, facing right. Each side is three tiles long. Its trail shows the instructions it follows.

completions.description: Turn a quarter turn to the right, without moving

feedback.initial: Replace pass with the forward move. With pass, the robot only turns on the spot.
feedback.success: Follow the trail. Both indented instructions repeat together. Can you make a smaller square by changing one number?
